name: Higgs Realtime
access: Boson AI API (wss://api.boson.ai/v1/realtime, OpenAI Realtime-compatible events)

voice.input_audio: audio/pcm (PCM16 little-endian mono at 8000, 16000, 24000 or 48000 Hz, default 24000), audio/pcmu (G.711 mu-law, 8000 Hz) or audio/opus (24 kHz, frame size 2.5 to 60 ms, default 20); audio travels base64 in JSON events; near-field or far-field noise reduction is optional [boson-audio]
voice.output_audio: The same codecs and rates as the input, set separately; internal processing is 24 kHz 16-bit mono [boson-audio]
voice.voices: The default voice, named presets from the Higgs TTS API, and custom cloned voices (voice_<id>) made through the voices API [boson-audio]
voice.turn_detection: server_vad (threshold 0.55, prefix_padding_ms 300, silence_duration_ms 500, min_speech_duration 0.125 s), semantic_vad (adds a semantic end-of-turn judgment), or null for manual commit; create_response, interrupt_response and eagerness are accepted but have no effect [boson-turn] [boson-migrate]
voice.interruption: Barge-in always interrupts: user speech during playback cancels the response, stops the audio and truncates the assistant item at the interruption point; the client should stop playback on input_audio_buffer.speech_started; conversation.item.truncate trims an item by audio_end_ms [boson-turn]
voice.latency: Artificial Analysis: 1.47 seconds average time to first audio on its Big Bench Audio set [aa-s2s]
voice.session_limit: An idle timeout closes the session after 5 minutes without user speech; a maximum wall-clock duration also exists, and the server sends session.max_duration_reached with the value; the pages read give no number [boson-migrate]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Boson pricing page (read 2026-10-03), token-billed per million tokens; the page also gives estimates of US$0.0023 per minute of audio input and US$0.014 per minute of audio output, and US$0.0025 per minute for input transcription with higgs-stt-3.1. Billing is prepaid; new accounts get US$10 of trial credit [boson-pricing]
